:::{#rem-kappa-prevalence}
#### Kappa depends on prevalence

When both classifiers call one category rarely,
the chance agreement $p_e$ is close to 1,
so the same overall agreement leaves little room for agreement beyond chance,
and kappa can be low even when the overall agreement is high,
as @exm-kappa-paradox shows.
@cicchetti1990high recommend reporting
the positive and negative agreements alongside kappa,
so that poor agreement on the rarer category is not hidden.
